title: F06: Upload + review/correct UI, corrections, confirm
milestone: M5 API + UI
labels: frontend, backend
---
## Goal
Scenario 1 end to end: upload a photo, review and correct the extraction, confirm the expense.

**Depends on:** F05
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The user can run the whole of scenario 1 in the UI
- [ ] Confirm is refused while any item is uncategorised
- [ ] AI-generated values are labelled
- [ ] Flagged fields and uncategorised items are highlighted
- [ ] Every field stays editable whatever the review status; flags and the review status are recomputed after each create or edit (`domain.confidence.assess`)
- [ ] A `null` field is shown as "unknown, please fill in"
- [ ] A `not_a_receipt` receipt says the image wasn't recognised as a receipt and offers Retry or Enter manually with an empty form
